stem: Generally, where are coral reefs found?

options.label: b
options.text: Between Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn coastal areas

options.label: c
options.text: On both east and west coasts of continents and islands only

expl: Most of the world’s coral reefs are found in eastern and western coastal areas between the Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn (generally extending between 300N to 300S). Australia’s Great Barrier Reef is the world’s largest coral reef. Coral reefs cover 0.08% to 0.16% of our oceans but they contain 25% of the world’s marine species.

options.label: d
options.text: A range of the Rocky Mountains

expl: The Great Barrier Reef is the world’s largest coral reef .The reef is located in the Pacific Ocean, off the coast of Queensland in Northeast Australia. A total 2300 km long coral reef lies between 100 south to 240 south. The Great Barrier Reef supports extraordinary biodiversity, including more than 450 species of hard corals, 1625 species of fish and over 3000 species of molluscs.

stem:
Consider the following statements :
1. Most of the world's coral reefs are in tropical waters.
2. More than one-third of the world's coral reefs are located in the territories of Australia, Indonesia and Philippines.
3. Coral reefs host far more number of animal phyla than those hosted by tropical rainforests.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
expl: Coral reefs are formed by the consolidation and combination of the skeletons of marine organisms, coral or coral polyps. Significantly, coral reefs generally are confined to tropical and semi-tropical waters (mostly 250N to 250S). Somewhere their expansion is 300N to 300S. Hence statement (1) is correct. According to Reef Base : A Global Information System for Coral Reef, about 19 % of the world's total coral reef areas are in Australia and 17% in Indonesia respectively. Thus it can be said that more than one-third of the world's coral reefs are found in the territories of Australia, Indonesia and the Philippines. Hence statement (2) is also correct. Some of the renowned environmentalists estimate that more than 25,000 described species from thirty two of the worl's thirty-three animal phyla live in reef habitats. It is almost four times the number of animal phyla found in tropical rainforests. Thus we can say that statement (3) is also correct. Hence option (d) is correct.

stem: Addu Atoll are situated in which ocean?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Addu Atoll is situated in the Indian Ocean. It is the southernmost atoll of the Maldives.

An atoll is a ring-shaped island that includes a coral reef surrounding a lagoon. They are generally circular or horseshoe-shaped, with diameters that can span several kilometers. These structures are typically found in tropical and subtropical oceans and seas where coral can grow. Atolls can be complex and vibrant structures. They may include various reefs that are large enough to support tropical islands and even small towns.
